definitions.explanation: The act of moving personnel to different positions or departments within an organization, or rearranging the placement of objects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配置換|はいちが}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{配置換|はいちが}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I'm being reassigned to a different department starting next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦オフィス→オフィス：00327_ofisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配置換|はいちが}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ことにした。
examples.english: We decided to rearrange the office layout to improve efficiency.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧ (arrangement, placement) + {換|か}え (changing, replacing). Most commonly refers to personnel transfers within an organization but can also mean physically rearranging items or spaces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧{配置換|はいちが}え: personnel reshuffling
- {配置換|はいちが}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be reassigned
- {配置換|はいちが}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out a reshuffling
- {配置換|はいちが}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じられる→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧: to be ordered to transfer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧: transfer, reassignment — the standard HR term for job transfers; {配置換|はいちが}え emphasizes the rearrangement aspect
- ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧: job transfer (to different location) — implies geographic relocation; {配置換|はいちが}え can be within the same office
- ⟦{模様替|もようが}え→模様替え：07708_moyougae⟧: redecorating, rearranging — for rooms and spaces; {配置換|はいちが}え focuses on functional arrangement
